Are you ready to discover the secrets of budget travel in Istanbul? I took a trip to this stunning city and found that meals cost less than 100 Rs and a bottle of water was only 10 Rs! But the real gem of my trip was the Istanbulkart, which allowed me to explore the city affordably and conveniently. Want to know more? Watch my video and I'll spill all the details. But beware - there were a few disappointments along the way that you won't want to miss.
